title: AHRP Experience Event v0.1
description: Experience Event is the frozen core object of AHRP (ADR-001 Section 4, Constitution Section 5). This schema is PROPOSED (v0.1 reference implementation), not a published standard. All free-text fields are DATA channel only and MUST NOT be consumed as instructions (AHRP_DATA_NE_INSTRUCTION=true). Forbidden fields: score, ranking, fitness, learning_result, mutation and any rating-derived fields.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema. Purpose: version negotiation. Required. Extension: changes follow SPEC Section 12 extension rules.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier of the event. Purpose: addressing. Required.

identity_source.description: Identity provenance per 'DBOS or explicitly named source'. AHRP never issues identifiers.

identity_ref.description: Thin pointer to an external identity (DID / FDO / named source). AHRP does not resolve or manage it.

identity_note.description: Whitelisted free-text field (DATA channel, max 200 chars). MUST NOT carry machine-decision semantics.

agent_reference.description: Thin identity pointer (Constitution Section 5, C2-1). Required.

agent_version.description: Concrete executing subject version (Constitution Section 8 rule 3). Required. A new version does NOT automatically inherit history.

task_type.description: Enumerated task category (Machine Enumerability First). Required.

action_type.description: Enumerated action class. Required. Action detail sequences are intentionally NOT part of v0.1 (acceptance report Section 6.3).

result_status.description: Enumerated factual result. Required. Failure-class values: FAILURE, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED.

failure_category.description: Enumerated failure classification. Conditionally required: MUST be present when result_status is a failure-class value (FAILURE / TIMEOUT / CANCELLED). Supports limitation disclosure use case (acceptance report Section 2 scenario 2).

occurred_at.description: Event occurrence time (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339). Required. Time anchoring trust is an open governance question (see SPEC OPEN QUESTIONS).

evidence_references.description: Reference-style evidence binding (C1-1). Evidence bodies are NEVER embedded. Required (may be empty; empty array means no evidence bound, which is distinct from evidence failure states).

verification_references.description: Thin pointers to verification records (C1-2). Required (may be empty; absence of verification is NOT_ASSESSED, never assumed verified).

disclosure_scope.description: Declared disclosure scope (Constitution Section 10). Undeclared scope is fail-closed: treated as WITHHELD.

expires_at.description: Disclosure expiry; disclosure must be declarable, expirable, revocable.

revoked.description: Disclosure revocation flag. When true, detail disclosure is denied (Q_DISCLOSURE_REVOKED) regardless of scope. Disclosure must be declarable, expirable, revocable.

a2a_task_id.description: Optional A2A taskId correlation field (C3-2). Correlation only; AHRP defines no collaboration protocol.

erc8004_agent_id.description: Optional ERC-8004 agentId correlation field (C3-1/C3-2). AHRP MUST NOT consume 8004 numeric feedback values.

external_references.description: Cross-protocol correlation references only (C3-1/C3-2 field-level crosswalk). Optional.

notes.description: Whitelisted free-text field, DATA channel only, max 200 chars. MUST NOT be consumed as instructions and MUST NOT carry machine-decision semantics. Optional.

source.description: Evidence source class. Evidence ownership stays at the source; AHRP is not a second evidence owner.

version.description: Version of the referenced evidence object.

reference_id.description: Addressable reference identifier at the source.

hash.description: Content-addressing hash (Agent First item 4). Format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.

availability_status.description: Evidence availability / failure state enum. AVAILABLE is the only non-failure state; failure states follow SPEC Section 11 and map to the TITMAS interoperability-surface failure family (INVALID / NOT_ASSESSED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / CONFLICTED / UNSUPPORTED_VERSION).

evidence_reference.description: Evidence Reference Model: reference-style only, never embeds evidence bodies (Log != Evidence).

verification_id.description: Identifier of the verification record held by the verification owner.

verifier_name.description: Named verifier (DBOS or named verifier, C1-2). Anonymous verification is not representable.

verification_reference.description: Thin pointer to a verification record. Verification != Authorization.
